_meta.description: Gloria's profile, consent settings and trusted contacts for the Heads-Up agent. All data is fictional sample data rebuilt from the ShiftKey persona screenshots. Phone numbers use the 555 range; emails use example.com — swap in your own test accounts.
_meta.note_on_assumptions: Fields marked with an 'assumed' key are not in the persona and were invented so the prototype has something to work with.

consent.share_with_family: Only whether a specific change was confirmed. Never message contents or phone activity.

sane_new_time_window._note: A new time outside this is treated as a likely AM/PM misread; agent asks

contact_plan._note: Revised after pitch review: Gloria prefers calls and picks up her phone ~2x a day, so a phone call is the main channel. Email is the written record.

quiet_hours._note: No calls in this window unless the event is within call_immediately_if_event_within_minutes

contact_plan.call_script: Hi Gloria, this is Heads-Up with a message from {sender}. {change_sentence} Your calendar is updated and your phone will remind you at {alert_time}. Press 1 if you got this.
contact_plan.record_email: Large print, sent with the first call, includes the 'Got it' link
contact_plan.prototype_note: Calls run on a simulated call screen in Streamlit; a real Twilio call is a stretch goal

phone_usage_week_oct_19_25._source: Persona Screen Time screenshots (used for the before/after story, not by the agent)
